description: This file contains functions related to macOS launch agent overrides, environment variable management, and startup optimization hints for the OpenClaw project, including platform-specific checks and environment configuration suggestions.

methods.name: resolveHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the user's home directory using environment variables or os module.

methods.name: noteMacLaunchAgentOverrides
methods.description: Checks for a specific marker file in the user's home directory on macOS and notes if launch agent writes are disabled.

methods.name: launchctlGetenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from launchctl on macOS.

methods.name: hasConfigGatewayCreds
methods.description: Checks if the OpenClaw configuration has gateway credentials set.

methods.name: noteMacLaunchctlGatewayEnvOverrides
methods.description: Notes environment variable overrides related to launchctl gateway tokens and passwords on macOS.

methods.name: isTruthyEnvValue
methods.description: Checks if a string environment value is non-empty and meaningful.

methods.name: isTmpCompileCachePath
methods.description: Determines if a cache path points to temporary directories like /tmp or /private/tmp.

methods.name: noteStartupOptimizationHints
methods.description: Provides startup optimization suggestions based on environment, platform, and hardware conditions.
